paite: Huan Jonin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: Ka thugen hoihtakin ngaikhia unla, hiai na khamuanna thu uh hihen.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

paite: Honthuak teitei unla, ka hon-gen ding a, ka gen khit chiangin nuihsan na nu teh.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.

paite: Kei phunna mihing tungah ahi ahia? Bangdia kuhkalloua omlou ding ka hia?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

paite: Honen unla, lamdang sa unla, khutin na kam uh hum un.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

paite: Ka ngaihtuahin ka lung a donga, linnain ka sa a man nak.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

paite: Bangjiakin ahia migilou a hina, tekkuna a dama, a hong thupikhiak?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

paite: A suante uh a kiang uah a mitmuh uah a hihkipa, a gil ua gahte a mai ma uah.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

paite: A inleloute uh lauhuai lakah a bita, Pathian chiang a tunguah a ke kei hi.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

paite: A bawngtal un chi a khah a, a juau ngeikei, a bawngpi un nou a nei a, a nou a siat ngeikei.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

paite: Ganhon bangin a taneute uh a pawtsak ua, a tate uh a lam uh.
english: They send forth their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

paite: A pekging uleh kaihging toh kituakin la a sa ua, a tamngai ging uah a kipak uh.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

paite: A nite uh lamzangtakin a zang ua, lungmuangin Seol ah a paisuk uh.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. .

paite: Huan, Pathian kiangah, Honpaisan in, na lampite theih ka kilawp kei uh.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

paite: Bangkimhihthei banga a hih, a na ka sep ding uh, A kianga ka thum un punna banga ka muh ding uh? a chi uh.
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

paite: Ngaiin; a lamzanna uh a khut ua om ahi kei ahia? Migilou lemtheihna kei akipana gamlapia om ahi.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: Migilou meisel bangzah vei tak a mita, vangtahna a tung ua a tuna, a thangpaihnaa Pathianin lungkhamna a piak chiat?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

paite: Bangzah vei ahia buhpawl huih mut bang a hihua, buhsi huihpi mutmang bang a hih uh?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

paite: Pathianin gitlouhnate a tate uh adingin a kholkhawm, na chi ua, amau tungah tungsak le ake, a theihsiam nadingun.
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

paite: Amau mit ngeiin a siatna uh mu uhenla, Bangkimhihthei thangpaihna dawn uhen.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

paite: Aman nungin a in uh amau adin banga ahih, a kha zah uh hihtawp a hih nungin?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

paite: Kuan ahia Pathian theihna sinsak ding? aman lah sangpia omte vai a hawmsak ngala.
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

paite: A lutlaiin mi a si a, nuamsa leh bittaka om in.
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

paite: A sa thauin a dima, a guhngekte leng nawnnain a dim hi.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

paite: Midang lungkhamtakin a si a, hoihna himhim chiam ngei louin.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

paite: Vutlak ah kibangin a lum ua, thanin a pumtuam hi.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

paite: Ngaiin, na ngaihtuahte uh ka thei, dikloupia ka tunga na sawmte uh.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the devices with which you would wrong me.

paite: Koiah ahia kumpi in a om, migilou tenna puanin koiah a om a? na chi uh.
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

paite: Zinzin mite na dong ngeikei ua hia? A gente uh na pom kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

paite: Migilou tuh vangtah niin hawiin a om a, thangpaih niin amah hotkhiakin a om, chih.
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

paite: Kua ahia a maitang a a lampi pulak dinga, kua ahia a thilhih banga amah din ding?
english: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?

paite: Han lama puak ahih laiin, a han ven ahi.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.

paite: Luiguama leitangte amah adin a nuama; mi tengteng in a nung a jui ua, amah maa napaite simsenglouh ahi uh.Bangchiin thumumal omlou piin hon khamuan ding na hia? Na dawnnate uah juauthu loungal bangmah a om kei hi.
english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

paite: Bangchiin thumumal omlou piin hon khamuan ding na hia? Na dawnnate uah juauthu loungal bangmah a om kei hi.
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
